logline: Three Navajo Tribal Police officers investigate crimes across the 1970s Four Corners region, drawing on Tony Hillerman's beloved Leaphorn and Chee novels in a slow-burn crime saga unlike anything else on American television.

bollymeter.basis: A 100% Rotten Tomatoes score across 84 critics and a Metacritic score of 82 reflected near-universal critical acclaim; reviewers praised Zahn McClarnon's performance and the show's serious engagement with Navajo culture and the 1970s Southwest landscape.

pull_quotes.text: A rich, complicated world with twisty, clever storytelling that keeps Dark Winds compelling.

seasons.review_body: Dark Winds debuted on AMC in June 2022 and immediately established itself as one of television's most distinctive crime series. Adapted from Tony Hillerman's Leaphorn and Chee novels by creator Graham Roland and directed in part by Chris Eyre (Smoke Signals), the six-episode first season set its investigation in the 1970s Four Corners region with a predominantly Indigenous cast and crew. Critics pointed to Zahn McClarnon's performance as Joe Leaphorn as a career-defining turn - controlled, interior, and lit from within by grief. The 100-percent Rotten Tomatoes score from 84 critics reflected a rare consensus that the show was doing something television had not seen before: a serious procedural built on Navajo law, land, and cosmology rather than borrowed from existing crime-drama templates.

episode_reviews.title: Part 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The series premiere establishes Joe Leaphorn and the Four Corners landscape with assurance, grounding the procedural in Navajo Tribal Police jurisdiction and the unresolved grief that will drive the season. Zahn McClarnon's performance and the Southwestern setting gave the show a profile distinct from anything else on US television at the time.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Leaphorn surveys a crime scene on land that holds its own kind of authority - a tableau that tells the audience this show operates by different rules.

bollymeter.basis: Critics and audience consensus held that Season 2 deepened the series' world while maintaining the 100 percent Rotten Tomatoes score, with reviewers noting improved character work for Kiowa Gordon's Jim Chee and a more confident narrative pace.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 returned in June 2023, maintaining the show's critical standing with another 100-percent Rotten Tomatoes score. The six-episode format - tight by American prestige drama standards - remained a strength, preventing the pacing issues that plague longer procedural seasons. Kiowa Gordon's Jim Chee and Jessica Matten's Bernadette Manuelito were given more room to operate alongside Zahn McClarnon's Leaphorn, deepening the ensemble. The series continued its practice of adapting specific Hillerman novels while expanding the cultural specificity around the investigation, drawing on Navajo and broader Indigenous Southwest tradition in ways that remained central to the stories rather than decorative.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 2 deepens the ensemble and sharpens the pace, making a case that this is one of American television's most consistently excellent ongoing series.

bollymeter.basis: An expanded eight-episode order and a 100 percent Rotten Tomatoes score continued the show's critical record; reviewers cited stronger character development and the expanded runtime allowing the season-long mystery more room to breathe.

seasons.review_body: Season 3 expanded to eight episodes in 2025, and the additional runtime gave Graham Roland's writers space to develop the investigation and its personal stakes across a fuller arc. The 100-percent Tomatometer rating held through the third season, with a Metacritic aggregate of 82 placing the show in the upper tier of contemporary American crime drama. The expanded format deepened the engagement with the Navajo world the show had built over two seasons, and audience response tracked the critical enthusiasm.
seasons.season_over_season: Eight episodes give Season 3 room the earlier six-episode runs did not have, and the writers used every one of them.

seasons.review_body: Season 4 premiered on AMC in February 2026, tracking the Leaphorn and Chee team as the investigation expanded to Los Angeles - a deliberate change of setting that brought a new visual texture to a series built on the Four Corners landscape. The eight-episode format continued from Season 3. With Season 5 confirmed for 2027, Dark Winds enters its fifth year as one of the most consistently acclaimed Indigenous-led dramas in American television history.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 4 marks a fresh shift as the investigation moves to Los Angeles, adding a new visual texture to the series.
